punchline: Ramsey admits the maths says to pay the costliest debt first, then tells people to start with the smallest.
thirty_sec: Dave Ramsey's snowball lists debts from smallest to largest, whatever the interest rate. You pay the minimum on all but the smallest and send every spare dollar to it. When it is gone, its payment rolls onto the next. He concedes that highest interest first is cheaper on paper, but says money is mostly behaviour, and early wins keep people going.
